propositions: Structured-output validation and recovery must execute through a single Pydantic Agent operation with a shared request budget
Retry context must preserve complete failed responses when they fit, and omit them entirely otherwise, never truncating authoritative input or history
Rebar deterministic extraction, fallback eligibility, terminal refusal behavior, and failure artifacts must be preserved during migration to Pydantic
Successful operations must report Pydantic usage exactly once; fallback/downgrade candidates must remain trace or journal events, not competing usage counters
All mode='structured' consumers (library/CLI/MCP/in-tree callers) must route through the single-operation facade
The bespoke structured-output retry loop must be removed only after compatibility suite and provider cache canaries pass verification
